page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc6.16xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 64 dedicated physical cores on an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor with an x86_64 architecture, operating at a base clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a 2.0 GB memory-to-core ratio. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps.

Benchmark results indicate strong performance in memory bandwidth for large block read-only operations and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, both placing in the top 25 percent. Passmark database operations and extended instruction tests also demonstrate strong capabilities. However, the instance shows weaker performance in LLM inference text generation for both small and medium models, placing in the bottom 25 percent. Other metrics, including single-core and multi-core stress-ng tests, static web serving, and Redis operations, perform within the average range.

Given its high compute-to-memory ratio and dedicated core allocation, this instance offers a cost-efficient profile for CPU-bound workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. It is highly suitable for multi-threaded decompression tasks, database operations, and high-throughput web serving. Conversely, it is less optimal for memory-intensive applications or LLM text generation tasks due to its lower memory density and lack of hardware acceleration.
